caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden shelf unit composed of three main horizontal sections, each forming a rectangular shelf, with decorative circular motifs. The top of the structure is crowned with a large, circular medallion that features a radial pattern of six elongated leaf-like shapes, with smaller star-shaped geometric carvings filling the spaces between the petals. A smaller sphere sits atop this medallion. Each of the horizontal shelves is edged with a band of diamond-shaped carvings and contains additional circular medallions with similar star or flower patterns, some smaller and grouped together. Below the lowest shelf, five circular medallions are suspended, each also decorated with carved radiating patterns. The entire structure and all elements are depicted in various shades of brown, resembling wood, and the carvings show consistent geometric designs throughout. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Pa. German Spoon Rack
